summary: Iteration 4 frontend E2E validation for Flint static site: Global Ch4t (ntfy.sh), Music (iTunes JSONP), refreshed Wisp proxy browsing, and regressions (nt.html tiles, movies, games, root). All 5 requested flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Global chat is genuinely global via fixed ntfy topic 'flint-ch4t-global-9f3a2c' — works, but note ntfy.sh is a shared public service; abuse/rate-limits could impact UX. Consider a soft client-side rate limit and profanity/length caps.
Music preview autoplay may fail silently under browser autoplay policies; a subtle 'tap to play' toast on failure would improve UX (not required).
